rationale: Goods line matches PO and receipt exactly (150 EACH at $18.00, clauses 3-4), and tax of $231.00 equals the recomputed 7.5% on the $3,080.00 net (clause 5). The $380.00 expedited freight line is permitted: contract clause 6.2 allows pass-through of buyer-requested expedited carriage up to $500.00, and the goods receipt records that production requested overnight delivery, so it is not a surcharge defect under clause 6. No defects; payable $3,311.00 requires AP_CLERK approval (clause 10).
